entry.title: GeonKick 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Geonkick MPC 1.0.1 — Gen2 MPC ## What's new IMPORTANT: Manufacturer changed from OpenMPC to 303inmyheart. Older personal MPC presets may need compatible copies. Use the separate Python converter; the plugin installer does not convert user presets automatically. Keep your originals. English PRESET INFO explains the change inside the plugin. The common converter supports Geonkick MPC and JC303 MPC, previews changes and creates new copies without altering originals, encoded sounds or plugin UIDs.

entry.title: GeonKick 1.0.0
entry.summary: First public release of **Geonkick MPC 1.0** for Gen2 MPCs. Hardware tested on **MPC Live III / MPC OS 3.10.1** only. - 16 pad sounds, three layers and nine oscillators per sound; synth waves, noise, FM and WAV import. - 2–16 editable amplitude/pitch points over the waveform; final Envelope view correctly follows the selected layer. - 118 native MPC programs, including the original factory presets/kits with retained credits and licences. - Tap-to-preview browser, remembered folder, separate samp
